name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Recount puts Trump-backed challenger in the lead of Indiana state Senate primary
changes.summary: State Sen. Spencer Deery, who now trails Republican Paula Copenhaver by three votes, said he will appeal.

changes.title: Trump Wants to Move On From the Middle East. It’s Not Letting Him.
changes.summary: President Trump is eager to declare success in Iran and Gaza, but he is struggling to impose his will in either conflict.

changes.title: Trump Stokes Islamophobia by Calling Democratic Candidates ‘Jihadists’
changes.summary: Along with his comments about Muslim candidates, Mr. Trump spoke disparagingly of Somalis in the United States, saying “they’re not smart.”.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: President Trump hid in an airport catering cart and was taken to a military jet for a secret flight out of country after the NATO summit last month.

changes.title: Homeland Security Intensifies Pursuit of Noncitizens on Voter Rolls
changes.summary: Immigrants who said they inadvertently registered to vote while obtaining or renewing driver’s licenses are increasingly facing deportation under the Trump administration.

changes.title: Trump announces staff secretary Will Scharf, who helped secure ballroom approval, will be his new White House counsel
changes.summary: Democrats have vowed to pursue investigations into Trump and his administration if they are successful in November.

changes.title: Minnesota’s Democratic Senate Primary Pits Angie Craig Against Peggy Flanagan
changes.summary: The Senate primary race in Minnesota will be the latest test of left-wing energy in the party, in a state that was convulsed by the Trump administration’s deadly immigration crackdown this winter.

changes.title: Netanyahu Walks Tightrope on Trump’s Gaza Disarmament Deal
changes.summary: The Israeli prime minister, facing a tough upcoming election, is trying to satisfy the sometimes competing demands of his right-wing base and of President Trump.

changes.title: Trump signs order on childhood vaccination recommendations, citing autism
changes.summary: President Trump is signing an executive order on childhood vaccine schedules Monday.

changes.title: Trump and RFK Jr. try again to upend vaccines for kids
changes.summary: President Trump signed an executive order on Monday about vaccines, saying children should get fewer. His administration has been blocked in the courts from changing the vaccine schedule. (Image credit: Jim Watson).
